segments.text: A self-hosted online file converter. Supports over a thousand different formats. Written with TypeScript, Bun and Elysia.
Any missing converter? Open an issue or pull request!
If you can't login, make sure you are accessing the service over localhost or https otherwise set HTTP_ALLOWED=true

Ensure [[p0]] and [[p1]] match your host user ([[p2]] and [[p3]]) to avoid permission issues on the mapped [[p4]] volume. If you get unable to open database file, verify the directory permissions or run [[p5]] on the path you choose.
Then visit [[p0]] in your browser and create your account. Don't leave it unconfigured and open, as anyone can register the first account.
All are optional, JWT_SECRET is recommended to be set.
Never expose the service to the internet with ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED or ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION true. Only allow users you trust to access the service.
when unset it will use the value from randomUUID()
A long and secret string used to sign the JSON Web Token
User ID to run the application process as (it first uses root to chown the files)
PUID if unset, root if both unset
Group ID to run the application process as
File creation mask for processes and created files
Allow HTTP connections, only set this to true locally
Allow unauthenticated users to use the service, only set this to true locally
Checks every n hours for files older then n hours and deletes them, set to 0 to disable
The address to the root path setting this to "/convert" will serve the website on "example.com/convert/"
Custom string that allows you to change the display name of the website in the header (max 26 characters)
Arguments to pass to the input file of ffmpeg, e.g. [[p0]]. See [[p1]] for more info about hw-acceleration.
Arguments to pass to the output of ffmpeg, e.g. [[p0]]
Language to format date strings in, specified as a [[p0]]
Shares conversion history between all unauthenticated users
Maximum number of concurrent conversion processes allowed. Set to 0 for unlimited.
There is a [[p0]] tag that is updated with every release and a [[p1]] tag that is updated with every push to the main branch. [[p2]] is recommended for normal use.
The image is available on [[p0]] and [[p1]].
The latest release on docker hub
The latest commit on docker hub
These are written by other people, and may be outdated, incorrect or wrong.
Pull requests are welcome! See open issues for the list of todos. The ones tagged with "converter request" are quite easy. Help with docs and cleaning up in issues are also very welcome!

blocks.text:
# docker-compose.yml
services:
  convertx:
    image: ghcr.io/c4illin/convertx
    container_name: convertx
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - PUID=1000 # user id for file permissions (should match your host user id)
      - JWT_SECRET=aLongAndSecretStringUsedToSignTheJSONWebToken1234 # will use randomUUID() if unset
      # - HTTP_ALLOWED=true # uncomment this if accessing it over a non-https connection
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
